6,147 likes, 913 comments - yourfoodlab on October 10, 2026: "If you’re an iced coffee lover, you HAVE to try this one! 🫐☕️

I made this Blueberry Cheesecake Iced Latte and honestly, it tastes as good as it sounds! The best part? The latte itself comes together in just 2 minutes. The only extra step is making the blueberry compote, which takes barely 5 minutes.

Do give this recipe try soon & I’m sure you will enjoy it 🫶🏻

Happy frothing! ❤️".
